newsitem.title: UK: U.K. oil output down at 2.334 mln bpd in August.
newsitem.headline: U.K. oil output down at 2.334 mln bpd in August.

text.p: British oil production fell 170,000 barrels per day (bpd) in August from July to 2.334 million bpd, the Royal Bank of Scotland said.
Gas output in August fell by 169 million cubic feet per day (cfd) to 4.791 billion cfd.
Combined daily U.K. oil and gas revenues fell as result, by over one million stg to 39.9 million, although the decline was cushioned by higher oil prices.
Oil and gas revenues in August were 23 percent higher than the 32.5 million stg in August 1995.
